evidence: Spectroscopic ellipsometry (J.A. Woollam M-2000V) was used to determine the thickness and optical properties of the films. X-ray diffraction (XRD) in a h/h-conﬁguration was performed to analyze the crystalline properties of the films. Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXD) was performed to investigate the in-plane orientation of the crystallites. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) was used to investigate how the process parameters influence the chemical composition. UV-Vis spectroscopy (Shimadzu UV-1800) was used to measure the absorbance of the film deposited on glass and extract the bandgap energy via Tauc fitting.
